about: Pages whose shell code blocks run docker compose, npm, pnpm or yarn, with the repository and folder those commands run in. check-commands.mjs reads those files at one commit of the repository's default branch.

folder is where each code block starts, relative to the repository root. A cd to the repository's own name moves to the root. Any other cd makes the commands after it in that block blocked, because the check does not guess folders.
A page with one of these commands that is not listed here fails as not mapped.

docs/tutorials-and-codelabs/engine.md.folderReason: The page says to run the command in the codelabs folder.
